directAnswer: You can back up your iPhone using iCloud or iTunes/Finder on your computer.
summary: Backing up your iPhone ensures that your data is safe and can be restored if needed.

sections.heading: Backing Up with iCloud
sections.body: iCloud allows you to back up your iPhone wirelessly. Ensure you have enough iCloud storage available.

sections.heading: Backing Up with iTunes or Finder
sections.body: You can also back up your iPhone using iTunes on Windows or Finder on macOS Catalina and later.

steps.title: Back Up Using iCloud
steps.detail: Go to Settings > [your name] > iCloud > iCloud Backup, then tap 'Back Up Now'.

steps.title: Back Up Using iTunes (Windows) or Finder (macOS)
steps.detail: Connect your iPhone to your computer, open iTunes or Finder, select your device, and click 'Back Up Now'.

faqs.question: How often should I back up my iPhone?
faqs.answer: It's recommended to back up your iPhone at least once a month or whenever you make significant changes.

faqs.question: What happens if I don't back up my iPhone?
faqs.answer: If you don't back up your iPhone, you risk losing your data in case of device loss, damage, or software issues.

faqs.question: Can I back up my iPhone without Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can back up your iPhone using a USB connection to a computer, which does not require Wi-Fi.

caveats: iCloud backups require sufficient storage space, and free accounts have limited capacity.
